source.name: Mekansm
source.description:
Active ability: Activate when most allies are wounded
Heals 500 health to all allied units within the range. 

Range:400

descriptions.en:
Active ability: Activate when most allies are wounded
Heals 500 health to all allied units within the range. 

Range:400
descriptions.ru:
Активка: Активируется при получении урона
Исцеляет 500 здоровья всем союзным юнитам в радиусе.
descriptions.zh-cn:
主动技能：友方棋子有较多受伤时激活
范围内所有友军获得500点治疗。
descriptions.zh-tw:
主動技能：友方棋子有較多受傷時激活
範圍內所有友軍獲得500點治療。

source.lore: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.

lore_i18n.en: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.
lore_i18n.ru: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.
lore_i18n.zh-cn: 各种散件不知是怎样完美地组合起来，形成的散发着光芒的珠宝。
lore_i18n.zh-tw: 各種散件不知是怎樣完美地組合起來，形成的散發著光芒的珠寶。
